accepted_retirement.rationale: The owner-accepted shared NYCT namespace preserves the source literal Q7 separately from exact service identity mta-bus-company/Q07. The pinned snapshot proves Q07 scheduled with reliable GTFS coverage but not catalog_in_effect, so Plan 035 makes the binding current_ineligible and nonprojectable.
